rules: Read this state and the selected project's own state before execution; update both after verified work.
Unit tests, hosted execution, scientific support, independent replication and publication are different states.
Never convert a repeated disclosed outcome into a new protected confirmation.
Preserve negative, invalid, failed and inconclusive outcomes with their original source identities.
Do not activate a blocked protected evaluation merely because another implementation or source package builds.
Do not merge or expose private repositories when repairing public monorepo gitlinks.
Do not run an unbounded search for a positive result. Successor hypotheses need new versions and protocols.
Worldcastr is out of scope and must remain untouched.

projects.next_gate: Audit and publish the bounded negative result, or register a scientifically different successor before further development.
Resolve the exact pinned commit and authorized private remote. Existence of a separate private repository does not prove that it contains this gitlink revision.

projects.engineering_change: Register dynamic test modules in sys.modules before exec_module; original frozen outcome-bearing study unchanged.
projects.next_gate: Upload the newly hash-bound source bundle through an authorized Kaggle connection, perform the declared preflight, then execute the frozen S3 matrix once. No remote upload occurred here.
Recover the authorized source remote and exact pinned revision.
Recover the actual source and model contract. Bytecode caches do not establish a complete implementation or permit a scientific readiness claim.
Recover the authorized source remote and exact pinned revision before reviewing scientific or biological claims.
Retain the MAE improvement together with positive-gap/RMSE and calibration failures; obtain genuinely new evidence before claiming confirmation.
Resolve strict historical input regeneration using the recorded numerical platform, then regenerate and review the evidence-bound manuscript. Preserve the failed Linux verification.
Keep the direct-solver speed advantage and OOD limitations explicit; a learned warm-start improvement is not end-to-end solver superiority.
Recover the authorized source remote and exact pinned revision.
Preserve the predefined threshold failure and do not open held-out element evaluations; any materially different mechanism requires a successor protocol.

scope_limits: This registry covers the 11 project roots actually present in the audited new-wave repository, not every name previously suggested in conversation.
Frontier16 and other idea-bank claims require their own source repositories and current artifacts; earlier reports are not fresh executions.
No claim is made that all papers, new architectures, external replications, venue requirements or Kaggle jobs are complete.
